Given IPM can behave pathologically here, I'll remove all `highs-ipm` usage from the planner:

2. dual_by_lp: use "highs" then "highs-ds".

Note: `time_limit=20.0` stays as a guard (HiGHS does check its time limit in simplex iterations, and even if it's mid-factorization, it'll be bounded).

arguments.command:
cd /app/work && python - <<'EOF'
src = open('/app/submission/planner.py').read()
old = '''OPTIMAL_STRATEGIES = (
    ("highs", {"presolve": True}),
    ("highs-ds", {"presolve": True}),
    ("highs-ipm", {"presolve": True, "ipm_optimality_tolerance": 1e-12}),
    ("highs", {"presolve": False}),
    ("highs-ipm", {"presolve": False, "ipm_optimality_tolerance": 1e-12}),
    ("highs-ds", {"presolve": False}),
)'''
new = '''# Simplex variants only: the interior point solver can behave pathologically
# on some degenerate models, and simplex has been sufficient in all tests.
OPTIMAL_STRATEGIES = (
    ("highs", {"presolve": True}),
    ("highs-ds", {"presolve": True}),
    ("highs", {"presolve": False}),
    ("highs-ds", {"presolve": False}),
)'''
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
old2 = '''    for method, opts in (("highs", {"presolve": True}),
                         ("highs-ipm", {"presolve": True,
                                        "ipm_optimality_tolerance": 1e-12})):'''
new2 = '''    for method, opts in (("highs", {"presolve": True}),
                         ("highs-ds", {"presolve": True}),
                         ("highs", {"presolve": False})):'''
assert old2 in src
src = src.replace(old2, new2)
open('/app/submission/planner.py','w').write(src)
print("patched")
EOF
